title: DNS resolution failure causing service discovery breakdown
symptoms: socket.gaierror: [Errno -2] Name or service not known. All inter-service HTTP calls failing with connection refused. Services unable to discover each other via hostname. External API calls returning: requests.exceptions.ConnectionError: HTTPSConnectionPool: Max retries exceeded.
root_cause: The internal DNS server (10.0.0.53) ran out of file descriptors after a DNS amplification attack filled its connection table. The DNS service became unresponsive but the process was still running, causing health checks to pass. All service hostnames resolved to null.
fix_applied: 1. Restarted BIND DNS service on internal servers. 2. Increased file descriptor limits in /etc/security/limits.conf. 3. Added secondary DNS failover configuration. 4. Implemented DNS response time monitoring. 5. Added rate limiting on DNS queries to prevent amplification.
